W.note: Very small pill collapsed and a full timeline with ETA, carrier and number when open, with good ARIA, but dead space under the buttons and an odd wrapped Notify button.

X.note: Compact two-line collapsed toast with progress bar, clean open state with carrier, number, timeline and actions, though it lacks reduced-motion and dismiss is just Hide.

Y.note: Richest tracking with segmented progress and a NOW marker, but the dismiss X collides with the chevron, the timeline is clipped mid-row, and the actions wrap awkwardly.

Z.note: Tight, tidy and readable with a clear ETA and bar, but it ships expanded, has no reduced-motion handling, and its timeline gives little detail.
